Projected from docs/v15/the60_v15_assembly.step by hidden-line projection, with dimension text written from docs/v15/the60_v15/src/params.py. No hand drafting. The knob is drawn on its turned profile: the knurl is on the part but is not drawn.
MODELLED, NOT MADE — no v15 part has been produced. Dimensions are model values, not inspection results. Bodies tagged ENVELOPE or ASSUMED in the model are drawn as envelopes, not as the real part.
SECTION E-E scale 1.55 : 1
Right half, on the 51 deg - 231 deg axis, through the blower. Air is drawn down through the web, across the duct and out through the ring.
CL
5.0 duct
r 55.0 plenum starts
r 72.2 duct ends
r 87.7 edge
NOTES
One Delta BFB0305HA-C blower at 51 deg, sitting on a printed saddle on the
motion board's face and breathing DOWN through a dia 22.0 hole in the
core's web (the dia 24.0 inlet opening seats on metal all round, on a 0.3
foam ring). The Pi's own fan is off; this is the only moving air in the
device.
The duct is the space between the web and the closing plate: 5.0 tall, r
under 72.2, divided into channels by fins. The rear plenums at r 55.0 -
72.2 (az 22-66 and 308-338) are where the channels end.
Two circuits. The +y side is driven: the blower discharges into a trench
18.0 wide x 7.0 tall, r 66.8 - 79.0, roofed by the hood lid over az 33.5 -
59.5, and out through the ring's exhaust groove. The -y side is passive,
with 3 exhaust passages 10.0 wide at 311 deg / 320 deg / 329 deg into the
groove over az 300 - 342. Between az 40 and 61 the duct is solid outside r
64.8, because the trench sits in it.
Air enters through the ring's own openings and crosses its inner land
through 24 intake passages 9.0 wide, into the duct. Intake and exhaust are
separated by the arcs the exhaust grooves occupy: 18 - 60 deg and 300 -
342 deg.
Every through-cut in the core - the Pi window, the carriage hole, the port
slot - keeps 2.5 of solid wall around it, so the duct cannot leak into the
dry side of the device.
The closing plate is the service access: 9 M2.5 countersunk screws from
below on a 0.2 gasket. Nothing else opens the duct, and nothing inside it
can be reached from above.
DETAIL T - TRENCH AND HOOD 4.4 : 1
The trench runs from r 66.8, two millimetres of wall inside the plenum's
suction side, out through the duct wall and the core's shoulder into the
ring. The lid seals to r 80.5, 0.7 inside the wall.
PLAN AT z 3.5 - THE DUCT scale 0.55 : 1
51 deg blower
0 deg port
90 deg carriage
The fin channels and the two rear plenums. Air comes in at the rim all
the way round, runs inward along the channels and leaves through the
trench at 51 deg and the passive groove at 300 - 342 deg.
PLAN AT z 3.8 - THE RING ALONE scale 0.55 : 1
exhaust 18-60 deg
exhaust 300-342 deg
The ring on its own at the vent height: the outer wall's openings, the inner
land, and the passages that cross it. Everything the air does inside the
device happens between this land and the closing plate.
BLOWER, SADDLE AND HOOD LID - ISOMETRIC 1.5 : 1
The saddle prints on its flat top face - the face the motion board sits against - with the hood's neck walls growing up from it, so it needs no supports. Two dia 2.2 holes pass straight through.
The lid is flat, 2.5 thick, and butts against the saddle's neck.
